name: Agent
description: Give the model a task and a folder to work in. It writes and runs files, browses its own pages, and can generate images and video along the way.
extendedDescription: Experimental. Pick a folder, describe the job, and the agent works in that folder until it is done: writing and editing files, running shell commands, opening its own pages in a browser to check them, and generating images or video into the workspace. Good for building a small web page or tool, bulk work over files you already have, summarizing a folder of documents, or assembling generated media. It changes your files directly and there is no undo, so point it at a folder you are willing to lose. For games, use Game Agent — the same agent, aimed at that job.
